laneKind: code lane across two product repos; produces an UNCOMMITTED diff. The planner commits.
missionPremise: Operator ruling 2026-08-31, _decisions/2026-08-31_smartsite_ladder_recut_studio_works_a_list.md, plus its 2026-08-31 amendment by the P-101 scoping lane: Solo answers one parcel, Studio works a list of them. Screens and boards move from ungated to Studio-or-Team; the records package becomes a visible pricing row; the comparison table regroups to four; Studio stops being badged The packet. Prices untouched. Three operator calls ruled 2026-08-31: gate create_screen and add_to_screen while LEAVING list_screens open, split Studio two seats to P-102, route the site plan CAD divergence to P-104. Scope inventory not re-derived: _inbox/2026-09-01_p101-scope_close.json.
completionPredicate: A free connector user can still open the Smart Site panel and see an empty screen list, and is refused with a stated reason the moment they try to create one or add to one. A Studio or Team user is not refused. The pricing surface renders four groups, one of which names the records package, and Studio is no longer badged The packet. Every one of those statements is proven by a test that has been shown to fail when the behaviour is removed.
scopeBasis: Two repos, because they hold the entitlement gate and the pricing surface. Two NEW registered worktrees off current origin/main, never an existing lane checkout. The Studio middleware is a new module rather than an addition to peEntitlement.ts because that file is held by open PR #583 and is on the dispatch do-not-edit list. Excluded deliberately: Studio two seats (P-102), the three-copy consolidation of subscriptionTierGrantsStudio (named by item 3, not fixed here), site plan CAD sold-versus-enforced (P-104), the retired-price seam (P-103), and every price.

lessonsForPromotion.text: NEVER undo a deliberate violation with `git checkout -- <file>`. On 2026-09-02 that reverted the whole file and silently took the lane's real edits with it; the loss was visible only because a follow-up grep counted zero gate occurrences. Undo a violation with the same targeted, asserted string replacement that applied it.

In legacy-design-tools, a vitest mock factory for a module a NEW module imports should use `vi.mock(path, async (importOriginal) => ({ ...await importOriginal(), <overrides> }))` rather than hand-writing the export list. Hand-writing it recreates the internal-consistency defect: the test satisfies both sides of the predicate it is testing. Verified working for artifacts/api-server/src/lib/peEntitlement inside an isolate whose @workspace/db mock exports only six names, because peEntitlement does no work at module scope.

smartsite-mcp mcp-app.ts embeds functions into the served panel BY SOURCE (INLINE_SHARED). A constant a newly-embedded branch closes over must ALSO be emitted as a `var` in buildAppHtml, or the iframe throws ReferenceError and paints nothing. A unit test on the exported function passes anyway. The catcher is htmlContractViolations, and a new constant must be added to it in the same edit.

smartsite-mcp declareUpstreamNonOk (tool-honesty.ts) forces top-level `status: "error"` and lifts the upstream body's own `reason` into the declared `reason`, so a route refusal reaching the connector is NOT status upgrade_required even when the upstream said so. To make the panel render a capability-specific upgrade prompt, name the capability in the upstream body's `reason`; the upstream's own `status` lands under `upstreamBodyStatus` and is not read by the panel.
